utterances.speaker: JUDGE DELVOIE
utterances.text: Good morning to everyone in and around the courtroom. Mr. Registrar, could you call the case, please.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: Good morning, Your Honours. This is the case IT-04-75-T, the Prosecutor versus Goran Hadzic. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE DELVOIE
utterances.text: Thank you. May we have the appearances, please, starting with the Prosecution.

utterances.speaker: MR. STRINGER
utterances.text: Good morning, Mr. President, Your Honours. Douglas Stringer, Matthew Gillett, Thomas Laugel for the Prosecution.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE DELVOIE
utterances.text: Thank you. For the Defence. Mr. Zivanovic.

utterances.speaker: MR. ZIVANOVIC
utterances.text: Good morning, Your Honours. For the Defence of Goran Hadzic, Zoran Zivanovic and Christopher Gosnell. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE DELVOIE
utterances.text: Thank you. If there's nothing else, we may bring in the witness in closed session, please.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: We're in open session, Your Honours. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE DELVOIE
utterances.text: So I ask again, Mr. Stringer. Is there another witness available?

utterances.speaker: MR. STRINGER
utterances.text: Not at the moment, Mr. President, because of the strict scheduling constraints, if I can put it that way, regarding tomorrow's witness. We had to make sure that we didn't risk carrying over into tomorrow and so we have a little bit of gap today.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE DELVOIE
utterances.text: I understand. So if there's nothing else --

utterances.speaker: MR. STRINGER
utterances.text: Oh. There is one administrative matter concerning an exhibit that my colleague Mr. Gillett wishes to raise.

utterances.speaker: MR. GILLETT
utterances.text: Thank you. This is concerning a photo booklet which was admitted as P1037.1023, and that was admitted confidentially, but we've had a look and that could be admitted publicly. That is P1037.1023.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE DELVOIE
utterances.text: So, Mr. Registrar, it will be admitted publicly. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE DELVOIE
utterances.text: If that's all, then court's -- court adjourned.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE DELVOIE
utterances.text: to be reconvened on Wednesday, the 6th day of February, 2013, at 9.00 a.m. 21 22 23 24 25

procedural_notes.text: --- Whereupon the hearing adjourned at 11.20 a.m.,
